Author: tofuuHaus
Description:
[size=3][i][center]A female farmer
Married to Haley
Living on meadowlands farm 
Chose to save the community center[/center]
[/i][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/226539456-1731804819.jpg[/img]

You can change your name, appearance and other details at wizard's tower.
You can also change skill specialties at the sewer.
[b]I have not reached to the summit yet[/b], so you can change spouse or make 100M earnings for secret cut scene.

[b]No need to install any mods[/b] but there will be 2 error items in a chest next to shipping bin. They're from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] mod.

Also, Furniture layout may look weird because I use some alternative texture and content patcher mods. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2677]Mods list[/url] is in article section.

I placed some items in town area, so you have to install [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-134#post-121034]Non Destructive NPCs[/url] if you don't want NPCs destroy the items while they walk pass by.

For anyone who want more usable area, I recommend to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21694]More Lively Meadowlands Farms[/url] setting extra quarry cave and extra river branch uncheck. It's quite compatible. Plus, you can add a pond for ducks by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25528]Pond added to Farm[/url]. I recommend config the location (37,43) for a 10x7 pond in settings.

[b][size=3]How to install[/size][/b]
1. Locate save files directory
- For PC Windows, Paste “ %appdata%/StardewValley/Saves “ in file explorer
- For Steam Deck, The path is “ home/deck/.config/StardewValley/Saves “.
2. [i][b][size=3]Please backup your own save folder separately.[/size][/b][/i]
3. Extract my save folder in folder “Saves”
